title: How To Edit The SEO For Social Media Sharing for SEO Templates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Edit The SEO For Social Media Sharing for SEO Templates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682655 Steps Navigate to My Content > SEO Templates . Locate the relevant template and click Customize or Edit . On the SEO Settings tab, scroll down to the Social Media Sharing section. Update the fields as needed. Click Save This Page . Social Media Shared Image A Social Media Shared Image can be set for the template. As with other SEO settings, this is treated as a suggestion, social media platforms and search engines determine at their own discretion whether to use the supplied image. A generic, default social media image can also be configured; this is covered separately in the " How to Set a Default Social Media Image " article.
